userOrAssistant.title: User or Assistant
userOrAssistant.shortDescription: System feature: create calendar events manually or via the assistant. Ownership is chosen by workset (default builtin General); not an editable analysis task.

clientManager.title: Account manager
clientManager.shortDescription: External Agent (A2A): third parties assign work in natural language. Shares the assistant’s LLM and tools, but does not chat with you and stores no server-side history. Needs a full access key (`*`).

collector.title: Collector
collector.shortDescription: Collects messages and retries connections across platforms, writing raw messages to the database for the monitor wall and later analysis.

analysisBatch.title: Analysis batch
analysisBatch.shortDescription: Scheduler runs marker-based tasks (leaderboard, intel events) in LLM batches and writes analysis results. Project Manager tasks do not use this path — they are driven by editable Project Manager task schedules above.

outboundNotify.title: Outbound notifications
outboundNotify.shortDescription: Sends messages via Telegram, Discord, Webhook, MQTT, and similar channels when notification rules match.

localNotify.title: Local notifications
localNotify.shortDescription: Locally scans upcoming intel events, recurring-task (RRULE) expansions, and workset events, then notifies via voice, on-screen, or the last-day inbox.

retention.title: Data cleanup
retention.shortDescription: Periodically deletes messages, analysis results, leaderboard rows, app logs, and user events based on retention days.

startupGeocode.title: Startup geocode backfill
startupGeocode.shortDescription: On server start, geocodes intelligence events that have place text but no coordinates so the map can plot them. New events without coordinates are also geocoded during analysis; this pass backfills older data and will not block startup if it fails. Not editable here.

boot.unavailableHint: Common causes: backend still starting, or local DB schema mismatch. Current schema baseline is stamp 7 / SemVer 1.6.0 (SCHEMA_FLOOR 7; SCHEMA_MIGRATIONS is empty. Stamp 1–6: back up, then reset). Future stamps: update the application. Corrupt databases: back up, then run {script} to reset, then retry.

secretsBroken.title: Encryption key mismatch
secretsBroken.body: The local encryption key cannot decrypt stored API keys and source credentials. Enter the admin password to rotate the key and continue; tasks and messages are kept.
secretsBroken.infoBody: Tasks, messages, and the admin account are kept. Undecryptable secrets (LLM API keys, source credentials, action secrets) are cleared and must be re-entered. Telegram session files are removed; sources need to sign in again.
secretsBroken.fullResetHint: To wipe all data instead: after recovery and sign-in, use Settings → Data → full reset.

pipelineGuide.title: Start the intelligence pipeline
pipelineGuide.description: Connect an RSS feed, then tap a preset to create an analysis task. The first intel event will show up on Intelligence and Timeline.
pipelineGuide.stepSourceBody: Start with RSS for first intel — you do not need a Telegram session yet.
pipelineGuide.stepTaskBody: Tap Key insights or Extract schedule once, then bind channels and save in the editor. Tasks are not created automatically.
pipelineGuide.telegramHint: Telegram is the main body of sources; connect it after RSS works.
pipelineGuide.stepEventsBody: After the task is active, results appear as intel events; timed ones also show on Timeline.
pipelineGuide.stepAiTitle: Create an AI profile and bind the assistant slot
pipelineGuide.stepAiBody: Optional. Open AI provider, create a profile, then bind the assistant global slot. Nothing is auto-seeded.
